name: @qti-pie/plan-budget
description: The planning budget's two checks over any grizzle composition, as a test on a scratch installation with realistic data, never a grizzle feature: every served statement's and every armed commit-time judge's cold generic plan held to a planner-memory ceiling calibrated from the 100 ms bar, and each student action timed on a fresh connection at 1x, 10x and 100x data, failing over 100 ms of database time or when the pages it touches grow with stored rows beyond the child's own.

scripts.test: mkdir -p work/.vp-tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/work/.vp-tmp" NODE_OPTIONS="$NODE_OPTIONS --disable-proto=delete --disable-sigusr1" vitest run
